conclusions: Regional claims checked against narrowly scoped primary-source facts.
Original work and relationship advice distinguished from sourced local facts.
Meals and invitations leave room for preferences and consent.
No national personality rules, guaranteed business outcomes or invented certification.
Practical questions replace most source-validity quizzes and several implausible distractors.
limitations: AI editorial review; no native-speaker sign-off claimed.
The English-supported beginner exercises are a foundation; live conversation and listening remain necessary.
Official tourism/promotional sources support limited local facts, not broad claims about all residents.
